name: Cameron Dicker

background.fact: Cameron Lawrence Dicker was born May 6, 2000, in Hong Kong, and is nicknamed 'Dicker the Kicker'. He is a placekicker for the Los Angeles Chargers and, per Wikipedia, the only NFL player born in Hong Kong.
background.confidence: from Wikipedia (section stored in the data file)

background.fact: He lived in Shanghai for his first 11 years, moved to Austin, Texas in 2011, and did not play football until fifth grade in an expat youth league. At Lake Travis High School he was a two-time all-state kicker, and the team won the 2016 Texas 6A Division I title.
He kicked at Texas, where he started as a freshman, earned All-Big 12 honors, and holds the school record for field goals made. His college long was 57 yards (2019 vs Rice).
The Rams signed him as an undrafted free agent in 2022. He has also been with the Ravens and Eagles, and has been with the Chargers since 2022 (the data file lists the Chargers as the current team).
background.confidence: from Wikipedia and the data file bio

background.fact: Wikipedia calls him the most accurate kicker in NFL history by field goal percentage (92.8 percent). The data file shows 144 of 155 field goals in 70 regular season games (92.9 percent), with no field goal of 60 or longer.
background.confidence: Wikipedia, with the data file count close to the same figure

background.fact: Listed at 6 ft 1 in, 216 lb, age 26, jersey 11, Lake Travis (TX), Texas, depth chart K1, fifth year in the league.

The Chargers named him their 2026 Salute to Service Award nominee (USAA). Fan voting runs until November 30, 2026, and he plans a Topgolf outing for veterans with Merging Vets and Players.

Week 6 at Kansas City: 2 of 2 field goals, no extra points, 6 points. Week 5 vs Denver: 1 of 1 (42 yards) and 2 extra points, 6 points.

In 2026 he is 15 of 17 on field goals (5 from 40 to 49 and 1 from 50 to 59, a 52 yarder) and 10 of 10 on extra points, with 62 fantasy points in 8 games, 7.75 a game. His 2025 average was 10.0, 2024 was 10.53 and his career average is 9.37.

His best 2026 games were 13 points at home vs Houston, 12 at Seattle, 11 at the Rams and 10 at Buffalo. His worst were 2 points in Week 1 vs Arizona (no field goal tries) and 2 in Week 2 vs Las Vegas (0 of 1).

Per ESPN, Dicker has made multiple field goals in three straight games and five times this season. A CBS Sports headline from November 2 says he was responsible for all the Chargers' points that Sunday, and a Fantasy Footballers headline from November 9 says he made three field goals in the first half.

scouts_read: Dicker is healthy and set to kick on Monday night, so the question is how many tries he gets. The Chargers are 0-8, score about 15 points a game and are a 4.5 point underdog with a total near 38.5, which points to a low scoring game where drives often end at the 40 yard line or closer to it. That has helped his recent line, with 11 and 13 points in his last two games and field goals from 52, 46 and 43 yards. Baltimore allows a lot of points to kickers according to a preview, but weather is outdoors and cool. I would project 6 to 10 points, with a 12 point upside if he gets four tries.
